2608.02235.title: Domain-Specific Evaluation of Text-to-Speech Systems: A Multi-Metric Benchmarking Study
2608.02235.paper_summary: Recent advances in neural text-to-speech (TTS) systems have substantially improved speech naturalness and intelligibility across many languages. However, comprehensive evaluation methodologies that jointly assess perceptual quality, speaker similarity, and acoustic fidelity across diverse speech domains remain limited, particularly for low-resource and underrepresented languages. This paper presents a reproducible, multi-metric benchmarking framework for systematic evaluation of modern TTS systems through domain-specific analysis. The proposed framework integrates complementary subjective and objective evaluation protocols and is demonstrated through a comprehensive case study on a representative low-resource language spanning four speech domains: Formal, Conversational, Literary/Storytelling, and Emotional. Four state-of-the-art TTS systems -- Indic-Parler-TTS, MMS-TTS, Microsoft Edge TTS, and Google Gemini TTS -- are evaluated using MUSHRA listening tests, ABX discrimination tests, speaker similarity scoring with Resemblyzer, and acoustic analyses based on mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) and F0 RMSE over 960 audio pairs. Results reveal substantial variation in TTS performance across speech domains, with emotional speech consistently presenting the greatest synthesis challenge (mean MCD 12.03 dB; mean F0 RMSE 889 cents), while conversational speech achieves the highest overall acoustic fidelity. Beyond the empirical findings, this work provides a reproducible evaluation framework, publicly releasing evaluation scripts, result tables, and executable Colab notebooks to support standardized benchmarking and future research on TTS evaluation for low-resource languages.
2608.02235.paper_summary_zh: 最近在神經文本轉語音（TTS）系統的進展顯著提高了多種語言的語音自然性和可理解性。<lb/>然而，綜合評估方法學在多樣化語音領域中共同評估感知質量、說話者相似性和聲學保真度的能力仍然有限，特別是對於資源匱乏和代表性不足的語言。<lb/>本文提出了一個可重現的多指標基準框架，通過特定領域的分析系統性評估現代 TTS 系統。<lb/>所提出的框架整合了互補的主觀和客觀評估協議，並通過對一種代表性資源匱乏語言的全面案例研究進行演示，該語言涵蓋四個語音領域：正式、對話、文學/講故事和情感。<lb/>四個最先進的 TTS 系統——Indic-Parler-TTS、MMS-TTS、Microsoft Edge TTS 和 Google Gemini TTS——使用 MUSHRA 聽力測試、ABX 區分測試、使用 Resemblyzer 的說話者相似性評分，以及基於梅爾倒譜失真（MCD）和 F0 RMSE 的聲學分析對 960 對音頻進行評估。<lb/>結果顯示，TTS 性能在語音領域之間存在顯著變化，情感語音始終呈現出最大的合成挑戰（平均 MCD 12.03 dB；平均 F0 RMSE 889 美分），而對話語音則實現了最高的整體聲學保真度。<lb/>除了實證結果外，這項工作提供了一個可重現的評估框架，公開發布評估腳本、結果表和可執行的 Colab 筆記本，以支持標準化基準測試和未來對資源匱乏語言 TTS 評估的研究。
